name: 4d-blog-engine
description: 4D Blog Engine — operationalizes the 4D AI Fluency Framework (Delegation, Description, Discernment, Diligence) for content production. v0.2.0 adds /blog-init (one-time setup: declare blog project dir + GitHub repo + posts/images subfolders), /blog-start (mount the two directories and surface in-progress/unpublished pieces), and /publish (ship a signed post to the live site via git add/commit/push — no git commands required from the writer). The orchestrator's discovery walk now accepts a slim external-user marker (blog-project-instructions.md at the project root) alongside the MoxyWolf-internal cowork-project-instructions.md marker. Takes a base document and an angle question; runs a 30-day discourse sweep across reddit, X, Hacker News, Substack, Facebook, Quora, podcasts, and academic sources; layers a /council:deliberate synthesis pass; builds a verified bibliography with AI-generated abstracts; drafts the blog post in the configured voice using the existing research-pipeline + editorial-forge skills; runs a two-tier anti-AI-slop pass (deterministic linter + LLM structural review with a second-pass audit); and ships through a nonce-bound Release Owner Gate scoring against a 100-point rubric. On a clean gate, produces a publication-ready blog post, a long-form LinkedIn article (full mirror, blog stays canonical), and a short hook-led LinkedIn teaser with a 3-axis scorecard (thought leadership / pain / audience fit). Trigger phrases: 'write a blog post from this document', 'derive a blog from this whitepaper', '/4d-blog-engine', 'set up the blog plugin', 'publish this post', 'release-owner gate'. Implements the Release Owner Gate from MoxyWolf's 'Beyond the Prompt' whitepaper as the literal Monday-installable gate the framework prescribes.
